when.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks which savings account and credit card (and, if they ask, which new checking account) to open together to earn the most, or which checking + savings combination gives the highest APY. The agent recommends one combination. If the customer declines a credit card, recommend a checking + savings combination only and never suggest a card again. The customer applies for any card with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. The savings account is opened only if the customer asks, in opening_personal_savings_accounts. Never open a checking account the customer did not ask for. If the customer asks for a new checking account too, include it in the recommendation and open it only in opening_personal_checking_accounts.
starts.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

tools.not_used: This job only recommends. Opening the savings account is the job opening_personal_savings_accounts (see handoff_open_savings); opening a new checking account is opening_personal_checking_accounts (see handoff_open_checking).
Funding the new savings account belongs to opening_personal_savings_accounts, and only if the customer authorizes it.
Closing an old checking account belongs to closing_personal_checking_accounts (see handoff_close_checking).
apply_for_credit_card is one of the customer's standard tools, not a discoverable one, so there is nothing to give.

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address, plus the name or email used to look up the customer
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: date of birth, email, phone number or address?

info.about: How much the customer will put into the new savings account
info.ask: How much do you plan to deposit into the savings account?

info.about: Whether the balance stays the same for the year or the customer plans deposits or withdrawals
info.ask: Will you add to or withdraw from the savings account during the year, or leave the deposit untouched?

info.about: Whether the customer needs paper statements mailed. This rules out accounts that require paperless statements and adds paper-statement fees

info.about: The customer's approximate credit score, used to check each card's minimum score. The customer may not know it or may decline to say

info.ask: For the card application, what is your annual income?

Any Rho-Bank credit cards the customer already holds. Only the highest card APY bonus applies

Features the savings account must have, such as out-of-network ATM fee rebates

info.ask: Roughly how much do you expect to spend on the card each month?

steps.do: Retrieve the customer's checking and savings accounts: class, status, balance and date opened
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Retrieve the customer's existing credit cards, since only the highest card APY bonus applies
steps.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

steps.do: Ask for any missing facts before deciding: deposit amount, holding pattern, paper-statement need, credit score, card preferences, Rho-Bank+ subscription and monthly card spending
steps.if: any of these facts has not been stated
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Also ask, unless already stated: whether the customer is open to a credit card at all, any feature the card must have (e.g. travel insurance), whether they want a new checking account and any feature it must have (e.g. early direct deposit), and the highest ongoing savings minimum balance they can keep. Ask before deciding.
steps.if: any of these requirements has not been stated
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: If not yet stated, ask how long the deposit will stay untouched, whether to compare by interest minus card annual fees, and whether the customer would set up direct deposit into the savings account.
steps.if: holding_period, goal_metric or direct_deposit_to_savings has not been stated
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Unless already stated, ask whether the savings account must have any feature (for example out-of-network ATM fee rebates) and whether the new checking account must offer overdraft protection from a linked savings account. Ask before deciding; customers often reveal these only when asked.
steps.if: savings_required_features or checking_overdraft_protection_need has not been stated
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: If the customer's current checking account is not in a listed boost pairing, ask whether they would open a different checking account. If they refuse, count no boost that needs a new checking account, and never open one.
steps.if: open_to_new_checking has not been stated
steps.quote: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

steps.do: If the customer declines a credit card: stop asking credit score, card preferences, Rho-Bank+ and card spending; skip filter_cards, filter_card_features, score_unstated, fee_tradeoff, explain_apply, apply_card, apply_result and apply_check; never suggest a card again. In compute and compute_with_new_checking use as the card bonus only the highest bonus from a card already held in cards_get (0 if none). If the customer asks for another way to raise the rate, explain the linked-checking pairings: a qualifying new checking account adds its boost to the savings base APY.
steps.if: the customer says they do not want a credit card
steps.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

steps.do: Drop savings accounts whose opening deposit is above the customer's deposit (Bronze $0, Green Account (savings) $100, Silver $500, Silver Plus $1,000, Gold $5,000, Gold Plus $10,000, Platinum $25,000, Platinum Plus $50,000, Diamond Elite $100,000), and drop accounts that require paperless statements if the customer needs paper. For each account kept, note whether the deposit is below its ongoing minimum (Green $500, Silver $1,000, Silver Plus $2,500, Gold $10,000 or $5,000 with a Gold Rewards Card from cards_get, Gold Plus $25,000, Platinum $50,000); being below adds a monthly fee in compute.
steps.quote: Paperless statements are required for this account: Yes.

steps.do: If the customer asks about premium or higher-APY savings accounts, explain that each one's opening deposit or ongoing minimum is above their deposit, or that its monthly fee below the minimum cancels the higher rate. Then go back to the comparison.
steps.if: the customer asks about premium accounts or the highest possible APY
steps.quote: Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).

steps.do: Drop savings accounts whose ongoing minimum balance is above the highest minimum the customer said they can keep: Gold $10,000, Gold Plus $25,000, Platinum $50,000, Platinum Plus $100,000, Diamond Elite $250,000. An account kept exactly at its minimum stays in.
steps.if: the customer stated a highest acceptable minimum balance
steps.quote: Maintain at least $50,000 to preserve Platinum benefits.

steps.do: Even when the customer says high minimums are fine, drop any savings account whose ongoing minimum balance is above the amount the customer will actually keep in it. Example: Diamond Elite Account needs only $100,000 to open but $250,000 to maintain, so it is out for a $100,000 deposit kept untouched; Platinum Plus Account ($100,000 minimum) stays in when the deposit is at least $100,000.
steps.if: a savings account's ongoing minimum balance is above the deposit the customer will keep
steps.quote: Minimum balance to maintain the account: $250,000.

steps.do: Keep only savings accounts whose own documents show every savings feature the customer requires. For out-of-network ATM fee rebates: Gold Account up to $30 a month; Silver Plus Account up to 25 a month; Silver Account up to 15 a month; Green Account (savings) 20 a month only while the customer holds an EcoCard (check cards_get). Bronze, Gold Plus, Platinum, Platinum Plus and Diamond Elite documents show no ATM fee rebate, so drop them. compute and compute_with_new_checking use only the accounts left here.
steps.if: the customer requires a savings feature such as ATM fee rebates
steps.quote: ATM fee rebate cap per month: $30

steps.do: List the personal checking classes the customer could open that have every required feature. For early direct deposit keep only classes with more than 0 days: Blue (1 day), Green Account (checking) (up to 1 day), Dark Green (1 day), Evergreen (up to 2), Purple (2), Bluest (2), Gold Years (up to 2); drop Light Blue, Light Green and Green Fee-Free (0 days). Drop classes the customer's DOB (v_lookup) fails as of v_time: Gold Years 62+, Dark Green 17–26, Light Green 13–24. Drop Bluest if the customer cannot deposit $75,000. Leave out the class the customer is replacing.
steps.if: the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: Get direct deposits up to 1 day early

steps.do: Keep only checking classes whose documents describe overdraft protection transfers from a linked account: Blue Account (opt-in, $12.50 per transfer), Dark Green Account ($0 per transfer, but only for holders aged 17–26 by the DOB from v_lookup as of v_time) and Light Blue Account ($0 per transfer). Drop Green Account (checking), which makes no overdraft transfers, and every class whose documents describe no overdraft protection (Evergreen, Purple, Bluest, Gold Years, Green Fee-Free, Light Green). Leave out the class the customer is replacing. compute_with_new_checking uses only the classes left here.
steps.if: the customer requires overdraft protection from a linked account on the new checking account
steps.quote: If you opt in to overdraft protection, each transfer from a linked account to cover a negative balance incurs a $12.50 fee

steps.do: Drop cards whose minimum score is above the customer's score, cards that are invitation-only (Diamond Elite Card unless the customer was invited), cards that need Rho-Bank+ when the customer has none (Gold Rewards Card), and cards the customer refuses (for example, EcoCard has no credit-score requirement). Note each remaining card's annual fee: Bronze, Silver and Gold Rewards $0.00, EcoCard $50.00, Crypto-Cash Back $75.00, Platinum Rewards $200.00, Diamond Elite $495.00. Count a fee waiver, rebate or signup credit only if v_time falls inside its window and the monthly card spend meets its threshold.
steps.quote: Minimum credit score required to apply: 0 (0 indicates no credit score requirement).

steps.do: If the customer asks about premium or top-tier cards, compare them in dollars with their deposit: the Platinum Rewards Card has a $200.00 annual fee (its $150.00 rebate needs $7,500 spend every month; its first-year waiver counts only inside its window per v_time) and its bonus on the chosen savings account (e.g. Silver Account +0.2%); the Diamond Elite Card is invitation only with a $495.00 fee. Show why the recommended card nets more, then go back to the comparison.
steps.if: the customer asks about premium or top-tier credit cards
steps.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

steps.do: Keep only cards with every feature the customer requires. For travel insurance, the only personal card whose documents include it is the Silver Rewards Card (up to $15,000 per trip, $0.00 annual fee, minimum score 680).
steps.if: the customer is open to a card and stated a required card feature
steps.quote: Per-trip coverage limit: up to $15,000

steps.do: If the customer does not know or will not give a credit score, do not drop a card for that reason; tell them the card's minimum score (Silver Rewards 680) and that approval is decided by the application.
steps.if: the customer has not given a credit score
steps.quote: Minimum credit score: $680

steps.do: If the recommended card is the Platinum Rewards Card and the customer has not given a credit score, do not drop it; tell them its minimum credit score is 750 and that approval is decided by the application.
steps.if: the customer has not given a credit score and the Platinum Rewards Card is a candidate
steps.quote: Minimum credit score required: $750.

steps.do: If no savings account survives the filters, or the customer wants a card and no card survives, tell the customer which requirement rules each option out (opening deposit, paperless requirement, credit score, subscription, invitation, a card type they refuse). Do not invent exceptions, and stop.
steps.if: filter_savings leaves no candidate, or the customer is open to a card and filter_cards leaves no candidate
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: For each remaining savings + card pair, compute net yearly return: deposit × (base or tier APY for that balance (Silver 4.0% at $10,000 or more, else 2.5%; Silver Plus 4.5% at $15,000 or more, else 3.0%) + that card's APY bonus for that account from the savings account's own bonus table, taking the highest of the candidate card and any card already held in cards_get + linked-checking boost if the pair is listed + the Silver Plus 0.25% direct-deposit bonus only if the customer will set up direct deposit) − 12 × monthly maintenance fee if the balance is below the minimum − 12 × paper statement fee if paper is needed − the card's annual fee. Do not let the possible 0.025% relationship bonus decide between options; mention it only as possible.
steps.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

steps.do: Extend compute: also loop over each checking class from filter_checking. Add that class's linked boost for the savings class only when the pair is in the qualifying list (e.g. Green Account (checking) + Gold +0.75%, Blue + Platinum +0.8%, Blue + Silver Plus +0.35%, Evergreen + Green (savings) +0.55%, Purple + Gold +0.1%), keeping only the highest boost if the customer holds several checking accounts. Use only savings accounts left by filter_min_balance and cards left by filter_card_features. Rank by the savings APY and net yearly return; do not subtract the checking account's waivable maintenance fee, but note it for recommend_combo.
steps.if: the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

steps.do: When the deposit is $100,000 or more and kept untouched, also include in compute_with_new_checking: Platinum Plus Account 7.0% + Purple Account +0.3% (Dark Green +0.45% only for ages 17–26) + its card bonus (Platinum Rewards +0.4%, Crypto-Cash Back +0.25%, Gold Rewards +0.1% with Rho-Bank+, EcoCard +0.05%); Platinum Account 6.5% + Blue Account +0.8% (Light Green +0.65% only for ages up to 24) + Platinum Rewards +0.25%; and Diamond Elite Account 7.5% only if the customer can keep $250,000. Subtract each card's annual fee and pick the highest net.
steps.if: the deposit the customer will keep is at least $100,000 and the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: | Platinum Rewards Card | +0.4% |

steps.do: Recommend the ONE pair with the highest net return, explain briefly why (APY parts, the card's annual fee and the minimum-balance check), and confirm the customer agrees. If the customer asks for just one answer instead of options, give only the winner.
steps.quote: Confirm account selection with customer

steps.do: Add to the recommendation in recommend: the ONE checking class from compute_with_new_checking, giving the total APY with each part (base, checking boost, card bonus). Confirm it meets every stated requirement (e.g. early direct deposit days, the card's travel insurance) and state the checking account's maintenance fee and waiver (Green Account (checking): $22.50 a month unless the daily balance stays at $1,350; Evergreen Account: $6.00 a month unless the minimum daily balance is at least $500). Give one answer even if the customer asks for options.
steps.if: the customer wants or accepts a new checking account
steps.quote: To avoid the monthly maintenance fee, maintain a minimum daily balance of $1,350 each statement cycle

steps.do: When the recommended checking class is the Purple Account, tell the customer its monthly maintenance fee is $15.00 unless the minimum daily balance is at least $3,750.
steps.if: the recommended checking class is 'Purple Account'
steps.quote: Minimum daily balance to waive the monthly maintenance fee: $3,750

steps.do: When the recommended savings account is the Platinum Plus Account, tell the customer it needs $50,000 to open, a $100,000 ongoing minimum balance, and that a $50.00 monthly maintenance fee applies below that minimum.
steps.if: the recommended savings account is 'Platinum Plus Account'
steps.quote: The monthly maintenance fee is $50.00.

steps.do: When the recommended savings account is the Silver Account, tell the customer it needs $500 to open and $1,000 kept ongoing ($5.00 monthly fee below it), and that the 4.0% tier applies only while the balance stays at or above $10,000 (2.5% below).
steps.if: the recommended savings account is 'Silver Account'
steps.quote: To qualify for the higher APY tier, keep your balance at or above $10,000.

steps.do: When recommending, state how each required feature is met, from each product's own document: the savings account's ATM rebate cap (e.g. Gold Account up to $30 a month), the checking account's overdraft protection (e.g. Blue Account: opt-in, linked account, $12.50 per transfer; Blue's $20.00 monthly fee is waived with a $625 minimum daily balance) and the card's travel insurance (Silver Rewards Card up to $15,000 per trip). If the customer asks whether a recommended product has a required feature, confirm it from that document; do not switch the recommendation unless the document shows it lacks the feature.
steps.if: the customer stated required features for the savings, checking or card
steps.quote: Covered incident types: up to 5 categories (for example, trip cancellation or interruption, delays, lost or delayed baggage, or similar covered events)

steps.do: If the customer asks whether a card's annual fee is worth it, or the highest-APY combination uses a card with an annual fee, compare dollars: deposit × (that card's bonus − the best no-fee card's bonus for the same savings + checking) against the card's annual fee. Recommend the no-fee card when the extra interest is below the fee, and say so with the numbers (e.g. on a Green Account (savings): EcoCard +0.5% with a $50.00 fee vs Silver Rewards Card +0.45% with $0.00; on a $6,000 deposit the extra 0.05% is $3, far below $50). Recommend the fee card when its extra interest is above the fee (e.g. on a Silver Account at $10,000 or more, EcoCard +2.2% vs Silver Rewards +0.1%: the extra 2.1% far exceeds $50).
steps.if: the customer questions a card's annual fee, or the top-APY combination includes a card with an annual fee
steps.quote: Annual fee: $50.00.

steps.do: For a fee card on a large deposit, also compare it with the next-best fee card: on a $100,000 Platinum Plus Account, the Platinum Rewards Card +0.4% = $400 against its $200.00 fee nets $200, while Crypto-Cash Back +0.25% = $250 against its $75.00 fee nets $175, so Platinum Rewards wins. Show the customer the numbers with their actual deposit.
steps.if: the customer questions the annual fee of a card recommended in compute_large_deposit
steps.quote: Consider your net rewards after the $200.00 annual fee when planning large purchases.

steps.do: Compare the current time from v_time with the Platinum Rewards Card first-year fee waiver window (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31). Mention the waiver only if today is inside it; otherwise state the $200.00 annual fee and do not promise a waiver.
steps.if: the recommended card is the Platinum Rewards Card
steps.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

steps.do: Explain the order before opening anything: open the savings account first, because it needs an active checking account already held at least 14 days and a newly opened checking account does not qualify; then open the new checking account and have the customer apply for the card; close the old checking account last. If the customer pushes back, give this reason again; do not just insist.
steps.if: the customer wants to open savings and also open or close a checking account
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

steps.do: Tell the customer the agent cannot submit a credit card application for them. They submit it with their own apply_for_credit_card tool, giving card_type = the exact recommended card name (e.g. 'Silver Rewards Card', 'EcoCard'), customer_name = their full name, annual_income = their income, rho_bank_subscription = true or false. Say the application involves a credit check and approval is not guaranteed. Ask for annual income and subscription status if not yet given. If the customer applies on their own without waiting, skip this.
steps.if: the customer accepts the recommendation and wants the card
steps.quote: Consent to a credit check and submit any requested documentation

steps.do: The customer applies for the recommended card themselves
steps.if: the customer accepts a recommendation that includes a card and wants the card
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your personal information and income details

steps.do: Acknowledge the submitted application. Explain the card's savings APY bonus applies automatically once the card and the savings account are both held. If the customer reports an error or decline, explain what they saw and do not promise approval or apply for a different card unless they ask.
steps.if: the customer ran apply_for_credit_card
steps.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit cards to see whether the new card now appears on the profile, and tell the customer.
steps.if: the customer reports they applied
steps.quote: The system identifies all active Rho-Bank credit cards linked to the customer's profile.

steps.do: If the customer asks you to open the recommended savings account, continue with the job opening_personal_savings_accounts using the recommended full official account_class (e.g. 'Gold Account', 'Silver Account'). Do not verify again, and do not open a checking account unless the customer asked for one (then see handoff_open_checking).
steps.if: the customer accepts the recommendation and asks for the savings account to be opened
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account

steps.do: After the savings account is opened, continue with opening_personal_checking_accounts using the recommended checking class's full official name (e.g. 'Green Account (checking)'). Do not verify again.
steps.if: the customer accepted a recommended new checking account and asks for it to be opened
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: After the new accounts are open, continue with closing_personal_checking_accounts for the old checking account the customer wants closed.
steps.if: the customer also asked to close an old checking account
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

steps.do: If a lookup tool keeps returning a system error that blocks the recommendation, tell the customer, ask whether they want a human agent, and transfer only if they agree, using reason technical_system_error.

args.summary: what was done and which tool failed

steps.if: a required lookup tool returns a system error that prevents completion and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request

rules.rule: This job also covers a customer who asks which checking + savings pairing earns bonus APY (the former 'when' of recommend_credit_card_and_savings_account_combination)
rules.quote: Certain personal checking and savings account pairings provide bonus APY on your savings account balance.

rules.rule: The Green Account (savings) requires paperless statements. Exclude it when the customer needs paper statements
rules.quote: Paperless statements are required for this account: Yes.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account allows paper statements at $0.00 per month
rules.quote: Paperless statements are NOT required for this account (unlike Green Account (savings) which requires paperless).

rules.rule: Silver Account paper statements cost $0.00 per month
rules.quote: There is no monthly fee for paper statements; the amount is $0.00.

rules.rule: Bronze Account paper statements cost $2.00 per month ($24 per year). Bronze base APY is 2.0%
rules.quote: If you are enrolled in paper statements, a paper statement fee of $2.00 may apply each month you receive a paper statement.

rules.rule: Gold Account: base APY 5.5%
rules.quote: Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.

rules.rule: Gold Account: opening deposit minimum is $5,000
rules.quote: Opening deposit minimum: $5,000

rules.rule: Gold Account: a $10.00 monthly fee ($120 per year) applies whenever the balance is below $10,000
rules.quote: Monthly maintenance: $10.00 (charged only if your balance drops below $10,000 during the statement period).

rules.rule: The Gold Rewards Card lowers the Gold Account minimum to $5,000, but only if the customer can hold that card
rules.quote: The standard minimum balance requirement of $10,000 is reduced to $5,000 for Gold Rewards Card holders.

rules.rule: Gold Account card APY bonuses: Bronze Rewards +0.15%, Silver Rewards +0.2%, Gold Rewards +0.025%, Platinum Rewards +0.15%, Diamond Elite +0.3%, EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards +0.35%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%
rules.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: Tier 1 APY 3.0% for balances below $15,000. Tier 2 APY 4.5% at or above $15,000
rules.quote: Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: $1,000 opening minimum, $2,500 ongoing minimum ($8.00 monthly fee if below)
rules.quote: Fund your new account with at least $1,000 to open it.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account card APY bonuses: Bronze +0.15%, Silver +0.15%, Gold +0.2%, Platinum +0.15%, Diamond Elite +0.4%, EcoCard +0.45%, Green Rewards +0.1%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%
rules.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Silver Plus Account balance.
